title: Record cost and inference events for every harness run
narrative: Finance asks Nubble whether a harness run burned billable units. He starts the CLI host with the default pass-through family and a mock reason backend, uses the built-in one-shot infer universe (no custom recipe load), runs infer with a short prompt, and verifies completion by reading the event log: an inference event and a cost event with non-zero units — the same signals he would forward to billing. He also checks that those events carry the host clock timestamps he expects.
implementation:
CLI universe `cli:infer` via `CliInstrumentor` / `CliInferRunner` emits structured `EventLog` records for inference and cost (`CostAccountant` / `core:cost`, `core:inference`) on the same stream as graph lifecycle events. This is the baseline observability stream for every run — decisions, routing, and tools extend the same log rather than a separate ledger.

Covers: OBS-01.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenarios `event_types.yaml` (environment + infer step + complete event/cost/token expects) and `event_timestamps.yaml` (environment.clock + infer + complete timestamp expects). Cassette `response.json`. Related: `tests/test_events.py`. Live: `MECHA_STORY_BACKEND=live`.
